content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) has provided information regarding α-glucosidase inhibitors, such as acarbose and miglitol. The median Average Wholesale Price (AWP) for this class of medications is significantly high, ranging from $106 to $294. In contrast, the National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC) prices for these drugs are considerably lower, at $27 and $34, respectively. The maximum recommended daily dosage for these medications is 300 mg.
